comment: No source is published. What is above comes from the maker's manual, the panel artwork and the module's own port and parameter names. The mode button's own description spells out what modulation does in each mode: 'Repitch: pitch changes with time (MOD=wow)', 'Octave: +1 octave per repeat (MOD=tremolo)', 'Reverse: backward playback (MOD=chorus)', 'Ping-Pong: L/R alternating (MOD=wow)'. The panel prints the four mode names across the top and the button steps through them. The module also holds the note divisions 1/32 through 4/1 used when a Delay Expander locks the time to a tempo.
